name: terse
conv_prompt: 1 short imperative sentence. 'Set up the env at ...', 'Init the node at ...'

name: script
conv_prompt: 1 sentence about a CI/CD or automation step. Mentions a pipeline or deploy script.

name: runbook
conv_prompt: 1 sentence asking for the next step in a procedure. 'What do I run next for ...'

name: one-liner
conv_prompt: Wants a single-line command. Frames the request around 'one-liner' / 'one command' / 'single line' / 'one shot'. No multi-step procedures.

name: dockerfile
conv_prompt: Needs a command for a Dockerfile RUN step. 'What RUN command do I add for ...'

name: systemd
conv_prompt: Systemd unit-file context. Asks what value to put in ExecStart / ExecStartPre / a oneshot service. Typically references a .service file path or unit name.

name: incident
conv_prompt: 1 sentence, urgent. 'Need this ASAP', 'blocking deploy', 'production is down'.

name: onboard
conv_prompt: 1 sentence. New engineer setting up. 'Configuring my new node at ...'

name: migration
conv_prompt: 1-2 sentences. Moving from old system. 'Migrating from X, need to initialize at ...'

name: sre-oncall
conv_prompt: On-call SRE, terse and operational. 'Page fired, need to bootstrap at ...'

name: junior
conv_prompt: Junior engineer, hedging. Phrases requests with epistemic uncertainty (think / maybe / probably / not sure if). Often closes by asking whether their understanding is correct.

name: slack
conv_prompt: Casual Slack message, lowercase ok. 'hey what do i run for ...'

name: ticket
conv_prompt: Jira/Linear ticket. 'Need: bootstrap command for ... Acceptance: env is ready.'

name: frustrated
conv_prompt: Exasperated. 'I've tried everything at ..., what's the actual command?'

name: methodical
conv_prompt: Step-by-step. 'I've done X and Y. Next I need to initialize at ...'

name: error-paste
conv_prompt: Includes a brief error message. 'Getting "connection refused" at ..., how do I fix?'

name: already-tried
conv_prompt: Tried something. 'I ran X but ... still isn't working at ...'

name: handoff
conv_prompt: Taking over. 'Taking over from Alice, need to finish setup at ...'

name: automated-alert
conv_prompt: Alert response. 'Alert fired: ... not initialized. What's the fix?'

name: k8s
conv_prompt: Kubernetes context. 'Pod at ... needs init, what kubectl command?'
